rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you for offering help. Five hours per week is exactly what I need. Here's what I'm thinking: I want to map what's actually being worked on in independent AI safety research and what's conspicuously neglected. A lot of activity makes sense, but it's hard to see the gaps unless you look at the data systematically. Could you help me build: (1) a dataset of independent projects/people working on superintelligence risk, (2) categorize them by focus area, (3) identify where effort is concentrated vs. sparse? Starting point could be publicly available stuff (forums, GitHub, registries), then we'd add interviews with people in the network. The goal is a real picture of what's happening and where someone new could add most value. Does that interest you? If so, let's set up a brief call this week. Morgan"
rows.quote: Engaged Priya Raman with concrete project proposal (she offered 5 hrs/week)
